units.source_text: 老夫人全然不曾得知。

en.t: The old lady knew absolutely nothing of it.

units.source_text: 凡被鬼怪作祟的人，虽然病势很重，也有放松之时，

en.t: In people tormented by spirits, even when the illness is very grave, there are times when it eases,

units.source_text: 这期间神思便清楚了。

en.t: and during those intervals the mind becomes clear.

units.source_text: 这一天昼间，有一位阿阇梨做完了日中的祈祷之后，

en.t: At midday that day, after an acharya had finished the noon prayers,

units.source_text: 还在诵念陀罗尼。

en.t: he was still reciting dharani spells.

units.source_text: 他看见老夫人病势好转，心甚喜慰，对她说道：

en.t: Seeing that the old lady's condition had improved, he was greatly pleased and comforted, and said to her:

units.source_text: “大日如来倘不说谎，贫僧如此尽心竭力的祈祷哪得不灵验呢？

en.t: "If Mahavairocana does not lie, how could prayers offered with such wholehearted effort by this poor monk fail to be effective?

units.source_text: 恶鬼虽然厉害，但有业障缠其身，毕竟是不可怕的啊！”

en.t: Though the evil spirit is fierce, it is bound by karmic hindrance; in the end it is nothing to fear!"

units.source_text: 便用嘶哑的声音痛斥恶鬼。

en.t: Then, in a hoarse voice, he fiercely rebuked the evil spirit.

units.source_text: 这阿阇梨是一位道行高深而性情坦率的律师，突然问道：

en.t: This acharya was a preceptor of profound religious attainment and frank temperament, and he suddenly asked:

units.source_text: “如此看来，那位夕雾大将已经和府上的公主缔姻了么？”

en.t: "Judging from this, has General Yugiri already formed a marriage bond with the princess of your household?"

units.source_text: 老夫人答道：“并无此事。

en.t: The old lady answered, "There is no such thing.

units.source_text: 他是已故大纳言的知心好友，不负大纳言临终嘱托，

en.t: He was a close friend of the late major counselor, and has not failed the charge entrusted to him at the counselor's death,

units.source_text: 多年以来，每逢有事，无不尽心竭力地照拂。

en.t: for over many years, whenever anything arose, he has cared for us with all his heart.

units.source_text: 此次闻知老身患病，特地前来慰问，实在很不敢当。”

en.t: This time, hearing that I was ill, he specially came to inquire after me, which is truly more than I deserve."

units.source_text: 阿阇梨说：“老夫人此言差矣！

en.t: The acharya said, "My lady, those words are mistaken!

units.source_text: 凡事瞒不过贫僧。

en.t: Nothing can be hidden from this poor monk.

units.source_text: 今天早晨贫僧上这里来做后夜功课时，

en.t: This morning, when I came here to perform the late-night service,

units.source_text: 看见一位仪表堂堂的男子从西面的边门出来。

en.t: I saw a splendid-looking man coming out through the side gate on the west.

units.source_text: 那时朝雾甚重，贫僧不能辨识是谁。

en.t: At the time the morning mist was very thick, so I could not make out who it was.

units.source_text: 同来几位法师异口同声地说：‘夕雾大将回去了。

en.t: The monks who came with me all said with one voice, 'General Yugiri has gone home.

units.source_text: 昨夜曾将车马遣去，在这里宿夜呢。’

en.t: Last night he sent away his carriage and horses and spent the night here.'

units.source_text: 怪不得衣香那么浓重，教人闻了头痛，原来是夕雾大将来了。

en.t: No wonder the scent on the robes was so strong it made one's head ache; it turns out General Yugiri had come.

units.source_text: 这位大将身上常常散发出浓重的衣香呢。

en.t: That general's person is always giving off a strong fragrance from his robes.

units.source_text: 老夫人，这件事情其实不好。

en.t: My lady, this matter is in truth not good.

units.source_text: 他原是一位才高学博的人物。

en.t: He is indeed a man of great talent and learning.

units.source_text: 从他童年时开始，贫僧就秉承已故太君之嘱咐，替他举办祈祷。

en.t: Since his childhood, by the instruction of the late great lady, I have performed prayers for him.

units.source_text: 直至今日，凡有法事，都由贫僧一手承当，因此知之甚详。

en.t: To this day, whenever there has been a Buddhist rite, I have handled it myself, and so I know his affairs very well.

units.source_text: 公主和他缔姻，实在是无益的。

en.t: For the princess to marry him would truly bring no benefit.

units.source_text: 他的正夫人势力强盛，娘家又是当代巨室，高贵无比。

en.t: His principal wife is powerful, and her family is one of the great houses of the age, noble beyond compare.

units.source_text: 所生小公子已有七八人之多。

en.t: She has already borne as many as seven or eight young sons.

units.source_text: 公主恐怕压她不倒呢。

en.t: I fear the princess could never prevail over her.

units.source_text: 再说：女人恶业缠身，堕入长夜黑暗地狱者，

en.t: Moreover, when women are entangled in evil karma and fall into the dark hell of the long night,

units.source_text: 都是由于犯了此种爱欲之罪，所以受此惨报。

en.t: it is all because they have committed this kind of sin of desire, and so they suffer such dreadful retribution.

units.source_text: 如果被人嫉妒，这便成了永远妨碍往生成佛的羁绊了。

en.t: If one becomes the object of another's jealousy, it turns into a bond that forever obstructs rebirth in paradise and the attainment of buddhahood.

units.source_text: 此事贫僧决不赞善。”

en.t: This is something I will never approve."

units.source_text: 老夫人说：“这真是怪事了！

en.t: The old lady said, "This is truly a strange matter!

units.source_text: 此人向来绝无好色之相。

en.t: He has never before shown the slightest sign of amorousness.

units.source_text: 昨夜老身病体异常痛苦，叫侍女传言：且待休息一下再图晤面。

en.t: Last night my sick body was in extraordinary pain, so I had a maid tell him that I would rest a little before trying to meet him.

units.source_text: 侍女们说他暂时在外等待。

en.t: The maids said he was waiting outside for the time being.

units.source_text: 只怕因此而泊宿在此，亦未可知。

en.t: Perhaps he stayed the night here because of that; one cannot know for certain.

units.source_text: 他一向是个非常诚实而又规矩的人呢。”

en.t: He has always been a very sincere and proper man."

units.source_text: 她口上否认阿阇梨的话，但心中想道：

en.t: With her mouth she denied the acharya's words, but in her heart she thought:

units.source_text: “或许有此种事，亦未可知。

en.t: "Perhaps such a thing did happen; one cannot know.

units.source_text: 过去确有好几次表露好色之相。

en.t: In the past there certainly were several times when he showed signs of amorous intent.

units.source_text: 但其人实甚贤明，努力避免受人讥评之事，态度常是端正严肃的。

en.t: But he is truly wise, striving to avoid anything that would invite criticism, and his manner is always proper and serious.

units.source_text: 因此我们这边戒备疏忽，以为此人不会做出违心之事。

en.t: For that reason we on our side were careless in our guard, thinking he would never do anything against his conscience.

units.source_text: 昨夜他看见公主那边人少，便钻入室内，亦未可知。”

en.t: Last night, seeing that there were few people around the princess, perhaps he slipped into her room."
